titleEn: How Much Does a Bubble Tea Shop Fit-Out Cost in Richmond, BC? Real TeaByDo Project
titleZh: 奶茶店裝修費用列治文：茶百道 TeaByDo 實際項目詳解
contentEn:
A complete bubble tea shop fit-out in Richmond, BC cost between $135,000 and $140,000 in 2026. That is the real number from a 茶百道 TeaByDo location on Capstan Way that Reno Stars finished this year — and it covers far more than aesthetics. This post breaks down every dollar so you can estimate your own project before signing a lease.

What Does a Commercial Tea Shop Fit-Out Include That a Regular Renovation Does Not?

A bubble tea shop is a food-service business. That classification triggers requirements a residential renovation never touches: commercial plumbing beneath the concrete slab, a grease interceptor, equipment connections for tea urns and ice makers, and a backflow preventer on the water line. A residential contractor who has never pulled a food-service permit will miss most of these. Reno Stars has completed multiple commercial fit-outs in Richmond and understands what the City of Richmond requires before a food-business licence is issued.

The TeaByDo fit-out on Capstan Way illustrates the scope. Reno Stars demolished the previous retail unit — laminate flooring, track lighting, a metal spiral staircase — while preserving the existing mezzanine. Two new partition walls were built, and a T-bar ceiling installed throughout. The floor received Tesla White 24×24 porcelain tile with a metal baseboard, and the walls were finished with wood panelling. A custom order counter anchors the front of house, with stainless steel panelling protecting the back-of-house prep area.

  • Commercial under-slab plumbing: 2 grease interceptors, 3-compartment sink, prep sink, hand sinks, mop sink, hot-water dispenser connections, tea-urn connections, ice-maker line, backflow preventer
  • T-bar ceiling with LED panel lights, pot lights, and LED strips under permitted electrical
  • 2 sprinkler heads and 2 air diffusers added to meet fire code
  • Tesla White 24×24 porcelain floor with metal baseboard throughout
  • Wood wall panelling on all finish walls
  • Custom order counter + stainless steel prep-area panelling
  • Full repaint in Sherwin-Williams throughout

How Much Does a Tea Shop Fit-Out Cost in Richmond, BC?

The TeaByDo project on Capstan Way came in at $135,000–$140,000 for the full commercial fit-out. That range covers all demolition, structural preservation of the mezzanine, all trade work, materials, and citypermit fees for plumbing, electrical, sprinkler, and ventilation changes. It does not include equipment — the tea brewing system, refrigeration, or Point-of-Sale hardware are purchased separately by the owner.

A bare-bones fit-out of a comparable retail unit starts around $80,000 if the existing slab does not need cutting. A full food-service build-out in Richmond or nearby Vancouver typically ranges from $120,000 to $180,000 depending on the size of the space and the complexity of the plumbing required.

Fit-out LevelApproximate CostWhat Is Included
Basic retail refresh$40,000–$80,000Painting, flooring, T-bar ceiling, standard electrical
Food-service build-out (no under-slab plumbing)$80,000–$120,000Basic fit-out + hand sinks,prep sink, water heater, permitted electrical
Full commercial kitchen fit-out$120,000–$180,000Everything + under-slab drains, grease interceptor, equipment connections
TeaByDo project (Reno Stars, 2026)$135,000–$140,000Full fit-out with under-slab plumbing, grease interceptors, custom finishes

Budget overruns on commercial fit-outs almost always come from one of three sources: undisclosed structural work, unknown underground utilities where the slab must be cut, or scope changes after the city has reviewed the drawings. A pre-renovation assessment by a contractor who has done food-service permits in Richmond will catch most of these before you sign the lease.

What Permits Does a Bubble Tea Shop Need in Richmond?

Opening a food-service business in Richmond requires at minimum a Building Permit, a Plumbing Permit, and an Electrical Permit. If the floor structure is altered — which is unavoidable when you need new floor drains — a structural permit may also be required. The City of Richmond also requires a Health Authority inspection before issuing a food-business licence, and that inspection is triggered by the plumbing permit, not the building permit.

Reno Stars pulled all permits for the TeaByDo project as a single coordinated package. The permit process for a commercial tenant improvement in Richmond typically takes 4 to 6 weeks for a straightforward job; more complex plumbing can push it to 8 to 10 weeks. Reno Stars has an established relationship with the City of Richmond's building department and routinely coordinates permit timing to keep projects on schedule.

How Long Does a Tea Shop Fit-Out Take?

The TeaByDo project ran approximately 8 weeks from permit acquisition to handover, including the slab work. A comparable retail-to-food-service conversion in Richmond or Metro Vancouver typically takes 6 to 12 weeks depending on whether under-slab plumbing is needed. The most time-consuming steps are:

  • Permit acquisition: 4–10 weeks (Richmond, City of)
  • Under-slab plumbing (if required): 1–2 weeks for scanning, cutting, trenching, and curing
  • Rough-in inspections: 3–5 days per trade (plumbing, electrical, mechanical)
  • Final City of Richmond inspection and food-business licence: 1–2 weeks

Renovating during the summer months can add 1–2 weeks to city permit timelines in Metro Vancouver due to higher application volume. Reno Stars typically pulls permits 8 to 12 weeks before the planned construction start date.

How Do I Prepare My Richmond Space for a Tea Shop Renovation?

Before signing a lease on a retail unit you plan to use as a tea shop, have a contractor assess three things: the condition of the concrete slab and whether floor drains or new plumbing runs will require cutting it; the existing electrical service capacity, especially if you plan to add electric tea urns, refrigeration, or an ice maker; and the current sprinkler and ventilation layout, as adding a food-service operation may require additional sprinkler heads or air diffusers. Discovering these conditions after demolition begins is the fastest way to blow a budget.

Reno Stars offers pre-lease assessments for commercial tenants in Richmond and across Metro Vancouver. A two-hour site assessment before you sign the lease can save tens of thousands of dollars in unexpected costs.

How much does it cost to open a bubble tea shop in BC?

A Vancouver or Richmond bubble tea shop fit-out typically costs $120,000 to $180,000 for a full commercial build-out including under-slab plumbing, equipment connections, permitted electrical, and finishes. The TeaByDo project in Richmond came in at $135,000–$140,000 for the complete renovation excluding owner-supplied equipment.

Does a tea shop need a grease interceptor in Richmond?

Yes. Any food-service operation in Richmond that prepares food or beverages for on-site consumption is required to have a grease interceptor on the drain line from the prep sink and three-compartment sink. The TeaByDo project required two grease interceptors. Your plumbing contractor and the City of Richmond will determine the correct size based on the number of sinks and the type of food service.

What permits do I need to open a food business in Richmond, BC?

At minimum: a City of Richmond Building Permit, a Plumbing Permit, and an Electrical Permit. If floor structure is altered, a structural permit is also required. After permits are obtained and construction is complete, Richmond requires a Fraser Health Authority inspection before the food-business licence is issued. Reno Stars coordinates all permit applications as part of a standard commercial fit-out contract.

Can I convert a retail unit to a tea shop without major plumbing work?

It depends on whether the existing slab has floor drains and grease interception. If the unit was previously a restaurant or cafe, the infrastructure may already exist. If it was general retail with no plumbing, you will need under-slab work, which adds $15,000 to $30,000 to the project and approximately two weeks to the schedule. A pre-lease site assessment will tell you what infrastructure exists before you commit to the space.

contentZh:
列治文奶茶店全面裝修費用為 13.5萬至14萬加元（2026年）。這是 Reno Stars 今年在 Capstan Way 完成的茶百道 TeaByDo 項目的真實數字——涵蓋的工程遠超美觀裝修。本文詳細拆解每分費用，幫您在簽約前準確估算項目預算。

奶茶店裝修與一般裝修有何不同？

奶茶店屬餐飲類商戶，須滿足住宅裝修從不涉及的要求：混凝土地面下的商業排水、隔油池、煮茶設備及製冰機的管線接駁，以及回流水閥。熟悉列治文餐飲牌照流程的承辦商才能全面掌握這些要求。

Capstan Way 的茶百道項目展示了實際工程範圍。Reno Stars 拆除原有零售單位——複合地板、軌道燈、金屬旋轉樓梯，保留夾層；新建兩面隔牆及全屋 T-bar 吊頂。地面鋪 Tesla White 24×24 瓷磚配金屬踢腳線，牆面安裝木飾面板。定制點單柜台設於前區，操作區鋪設不銹鋼牆板。

  • 地面下商業排水：2個隔油池、三格水槽、備餐水槽、洗手盆、拖把池、熱水機接駁、茶桶接駁、製冰機管線、回流水閥
  • T-bar 吊頂配 LED 面板燈、射燈、LED 燈帶（含電工 Permit）
  • 新增2個消防噴淋頭及2個風口以符合消防規範
  • Tesla White 24×24 瓷磚全屋地面配金屬踢腳線
  • 所有飾面牆使用木飾面板
  • 定制點單柜台及操作區不銹鋼牆板
  • 全屋 Sherwin-Williams 油漆

列治文奶茶店裝修費用是多少？

Capstan Way 茶百道項目的全面商業裝修費用為 13.5萬至14萬加元，涵蓋全部拆除、夾層結構保留、各工种施工、材料及列治文市政府 plumbing、 electrical、sprinkler、ventilation 許可費用。不含店主自購設備（煮茶設備、雪櫃、POS 機）。

同類零售單位簡單翻新起價約8萬加元（若無需地面開槽）；列治文或溫哥華全面餐飲裝修通常在12萬至18萬加元區間，視乎面積及排水複雜程度而定。

裝修檔次費用區間含項目
基礎零售翻新4萬–8萬油漆、地板、T-bar 吊頂、標準電工
餐飲類裝修（無地面下排水）8萬–12萬基礎裝修＋洗手盆、備餐水槽、熱水器、許可電工
全面商業廚房裝修12萬–18萬全部＋地面下排水、隔油池、設備管線
茶百道項目（Reno Stars，2026）13.5萬–14萬全面裝修含地面下排水、隔油池、定制飾面

商業裝修超支幾乎永遠來自三個原因：隱藏結構工程、地面須切割時發現未知管線、或市府圖紙審批後追加工程。在簽約前由熟悉列治文餐飲許可的承辦商做預評估，可規避大部分此類風險。

列治文奶茶店需要哪些許可證？

在列治文經營餐飲商戶最少需要：建築許可證、管道許可證及電工許可證。若改動樓板結構（鋪設新排水管時不可避免），另需結構許可證。列治文市政府要求在發餐飲牌照前通過 Fraser Health Authority 檢查，而該檢查由管道許可證觸發，非建築許可證。

Reno Stars 為茶百道項目以統一協調方式辦理全部許可。列治文商業裝修許可審批通常需4至6周，排水複雜者達8至10周。Reno Stars 與列治文市建築部門有穩定合作關係，常能協調審批時間確保項目按期推進。

奶茶店裝修需要多長時間？

茶百道項目從取得許可到交付約8周，含地面工程。列治文或大溫哥華地區同類零售轉餐飲裝修通常需6至12周，視乎是否須做地面下排水。主要耗時環節：

  • 許可證審批：4–10周（列治文市）
  • 地面下排水工程（如需要）：scan、切割、開槽、固化約1–2周
  • 隱蔽工程驗收：各工种（管道、電工、機電）各3–5天
  • 列治文市最終驗收及餐飲牌照：約1–2周

夏季動工可能因申請量增大而延長許可審批時間1–2周。Reno Stars 通常在計劃開工前8至12周提交許可申請。

簽約前如何評估列治文商鋪是否適合奶茶店？

簽署商鋪租約前，請聘請承辦商評估三點：混凝土地面狀況及是否須切割開槽鋪設排水；現有電力容量是否足夠支撐煮茶設備、雪櫃或製冰機；現有消防噴淋及通風布局是否須追加以滿足餐飲要求。在拆除開工後才發現這些問題，是預算超支最快的途徑。

Reno Stars 為列治文及大溫哥華地區商戶提供租前置業評估。開工前兩小時現場評估可為您節省數萬加元未知費用。

在 BC 省開奶茶店需要多少費用？

溫哥華或列治文奶茶店全面商業裝修費用通常在12萬至18萬加元區間，含地面下排水、設備管線、許可電工及飾面工程。Reno Stars 在列治文完成的茶百道項目費用為13.5萬至14萬加元（不含店主自購設備）。

奶茶店在列治文需要隔油池嗎？

需要。凡在列治文經營現場製作食品或飲品的餐飲商戶，均須在備餐水槽及三格水槽的排水管上安裝隔油池。茶百道項目須安裝2個隔油池。管道承辦商及列治文市政府會根據水槽數量及餐飲類型確定所需容積。

在列治文開餐飲店需要哪些許可證？

最少需要：列治文市建築許可證、管道許可證及電工許可證。如改動樓板結構，另需結構許可證。取得許可並完工後，須通過列治文市 Fraser Health Authority 檢查方可獲發餐飲牌照。Reno Stars 在標準商業裝修合約中包含全部許可證申請協調。

可以在不做大型排水工程的情況下將零售單位改為奶茶店嗎？

取決於該單位地面是否已有排水管及隔油設施。若原為餐廳或咖啡店，基礎設施可能已存在。若原為普通零售而無排水設施，則須做地面下工程，額外增加1.5萬至3萬加元費用及約兩周工期。租前置業評估可確認該商鋪現有設施狀況。
